Messages.Author: Orpheus
Messages.Body:
A player thinks that using objects, including the ones that grant a bonus to
bleed or strength to a minion, is optional. I say nay, but have to be sure.
So, can a Laptop equipped minion chose to bleed for 1, someone with Brass
Knucles choose to strike for 1 ?

Orpheus

Messages.Author: tetragrammaton
Messages.Body:
No, usually items and retainers are not optional, much like
some abilities (e.g. Kite's +1 built-in intercept) are not.
So, you can't choose to "turn off", say, sport bike, tasha
morgan and the like.

ciao

Emiliano, v:ekn prince of Rome

Equipment, retainers, etc. are always on.
Using the strike option that a weapon gives you is optional, of course.
